name: Aircraft Construction

klp.performance: Describe the general features of aircraft construction.
Identify aircraft system pipelines, components, and aircraft gas cylinders.
Identify the types of aircraft safety pins, locks, and chocks used with fixed wing aircraft.
Identify the types of aircraft safety pins, locks, and chocks used with rotary wing aircraft.

equipment_list: Access to Aircraft (Cockpit, Cargo Holds, Undercarriage Assemblies, Air Crew Areas)
number_of_instructors: 1 Lead Trainer (plus Safety Officer and supervisory trainers as allocated)
